title: Effects of Strength Training on the Physiological Determinants of Middle- and Long-Distance Running Performance: A Systematic Review
claims: 系统综述中 20 项研究测量跑步经济性，多数显示相对对照组提高 2%–8%，但并非所有研究都如此。
每周增加 2–3 次力量训练、包含多种力量形式，可能改善中长跑表现。
力量训练未对体成分产生负面影响。

The review highlights several methodological differences and limitations that may explain discrepant findings and says future studies should ensure valid measurement and maximise control of confounders.

verification.note: Blagrove 2018 全文；2026-11-20 把“统一方案”改为原文的方法学差异与控制混杂建议。

claimVerification.note: 原文：“Running economy (RE) was measured in 20 of the studies and generally showed improvements (2–8%) compared to a control group, although this was not always the case.”
原文结论：“The addition of two to three ST sessions per week, which include a variety of ST modalities are likely to provide benefits to the performance of middle- and long-distance runners.”
原文结论：“measures relating to body composition are not negatively impacted by a ST intervention”；正文亦报告 18 项研究体重无变化，仅 1 项增加 2%。
原文：“Several important methodological differences and limitations are highlighted ... should be considered in future investigations”；建议 valid measurement 与 control confounders。原 claim 的“统一测试与干预方案”是扩写。
